AIImporter.label: AI Importer

AILiteracy.documentation: Skills, knowledge and understanding that allow providers, deployers and affected persons, taking into account their respective rights and obligations in the context of this Regulation, to make an informed deployment of AI systems, as well as to gain awareness about the opportunities and risks of AI and possible harm it can cause
AILiteracy.label: AI Literacy

AIOffice.documentation: the Commission’s function of contributing to the implementation, monitoring and supervision of AI systems and general-purpose AI models, and AI governance, provided for in Commission Decision of 24 January 2024; references in the AI Act to the AI Office shall be construed as references to the Commission
AIOffice.label: Artificial Intelligence Office

AIOperator.documentation: A provider, product manufacturer, deployer, authorised representative, importer or distributor
AIOperator.label: AI Operator

AIProductManufacturer.documentation: Entity that manufactures an AI Product
AIProductManufacturer.label: AI Product Manufacturer

AIProvider.documentation: A natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body that develops an AI system or a general-purpose AI model or that has an AI system or a general-purpose AI model developed and places it on the market or puts the AI system into service under its own name or trademark, whether for payment or free of charge
AIProvider.label: AI Provider

AIRegulatorySandbox.documentation: A controlled framework set up by a competent authority which offers providers or prospective providers of AI systems the possibility to develop, train, validate and test, where appropriate in real-world conditions, an innovative AI system, pursuant to a sandbox plan for a limited time under regulatory supervision
AIRegulatorySandbox.label: AI Regulatory Sandbox

AISystem.documentation: A machine-based system designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy and that may exhibit adaptiveness after deployment and that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments.
AISystem.label: AI System

AISystemPerformance.documentation: The ability of an AI system to achieve its intended purpose
AISystemPerformance.label: AI System Performance

AuthorisedRepresentative.documentation: A natural or legal person located or established in the Union who has received and accepted a written mandate from a provider of an AI system or a general-purpose AI model to, respectively, perform and carry out on its behalf the obligations and procedures established by the AI Act
AuthorisedRepresentative.label: Authorised Representative

AvailableOnEUMarket.documentation: Status associated with supply of an AI system or a general purpose AI model for distribution or use on the Union market in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge
AvailableOnEUMarket.label: Available on EU Market

AvailableOnMarket.documentation: Status associated with supply of an AI system or a general purpose AI model for distribution or use on the market in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge
AvailableOnMarket.label: Available on Market

AvailableOnNonEUMarket.label: Available on Non-EU Market

BiometricCategorisation.documentation: Capability where assigning natural persons to specific categories happens on the basis of their biometric data unless ancillary to another commercial service and strictly necessary for objective technical reasons
BiometricCategorisation.label: Biometric Categorisation

BiometricCategorisationSystem.documentation: An AI system for the purpose of assigning natural persons to specific categories on the basis of their biometric data, unless it is ancillary to another commercial service and strictly necessary for objective technical reasons
BiometricCategorisationSystem.label: Biometric Categorisation System

BiometricData.documentation: Personal data resulting from specific technical processing relating to the physical, physiological or behavioural characteristics of a natural person, such as facial images or dactyloscopic data
BiometricData.label: Biometric Data

BiometricIdentification.documentation: Capability where the automated recognition of physical, physiological, behavioural, and psychological human features are used for the purpose of establishing the identity of a natural person by comparing biometric data of that individual to to biometric data of individuals stored in a database
BiometricIdentification.label: Biometric Identification

BiometricVerification.documentation: The automated, one-to-one verification, including authentication, of the identity of natural persons by comparing their biometric data to previously provided biometric data
BiometricVerification.label: Biometric Verification

BorderControlSector.documentation: Sector related to border control management

ChangeCategory.documentation: A categorisation of the change associated with the AI system

ChangeDescription.documentation: A description of the change associated with the AI system

CommonSpecification.documentation: A set of technical specifications, as defined in point 4 of Article 2 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 providing means to comply with certain requirements established under the AI Act
CommonSpecification.label: Common Specification

ConformityAssessment.documentation: The process of demonstrating whether the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2 relating to a high-risk AI system have been fulfilled
ConformityAssessment.label: Conformity Assessment

ConformityAssessmentBody.documentation: A body that performs third-party conformity assessment activities, including testing, certification and inspection

CriticalInfrastructureSector.documentation: Sector related to provision and maintenance of critical services
CriticalInfrastructureSector.label: Critical Infrastructure Sector

DeepFakeGeneration.documentation: Capability to generate or manipulate image, audio or video content that resembles existing persons, objects, places, entities or events and would falsely appear to a person to be authentic or truthful;l

DemocraticProcessSector.documentation: Sector related to administration of democratic processes

EUDeclarationOfConformity.documentation: Document providing the EU declaration of conformity, as required by the AI Act, Article 47

EducationSector.documentation: Sector related to education and vocational training at any level and for any profession

EmotionRecognitionSystem.documentation: An AI system for the purpose of identifying or inferring emotions or intentions of natural persons on the basis of their biometric data.

EmploymentSector.documentation: Sector related to employment including workforce management and self-employment

FRIA.documentation: An assessment undertaken to evaluate how the AI use of an AI system might impact fundamental rights

GPAIModel.label: General Purpose AI Model

GPAISystem.documentation: An AI system which is based on a general-purpose AI model and which has the capability to serve a variety of purposes, both for direct use as well as for integration in other AI systems
GPAISystem.label: General Purpose AI System

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-13.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(13)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-14.documentation:
High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 14: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by 
Regulation (EU) No 168/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 15 January 2013 on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles (OJ L 60, 2.3.2013, p. 52)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-14.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(14)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-15.documentation:
High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 15: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by 
Regulation (EU) No 167/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5 February 2013 on the approval and market surveillance of agricultural and forestry vehicles (OJ L 60, 2.3.2013, p. 1)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-15.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(15)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-16.documentation:
High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 16: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by 
Directive 2014/90/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 July 2014 on marine equipment and repealing Council Directive 96/98/EC (OJ L 257, 28.8.2014, p. 146)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-16.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(16)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-17.documentation:
High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 17: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by 
Directive (EU) 2016/797 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 May 2016 on the interoperability of the rail system within the European Union (OJ L 138, 26.5.2016, p. 44)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-17.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(17)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-18.documentation:
High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 18: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by 
Regulation (EU) 2018/858 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 30 May 2018 on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles, amending Regulations (EC) No 715/2007 and (EC) No 595/2009 and repealing Directive 2007/46/EC (OJ L 151, 14.6.2018, p. 1)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-18.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(18)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-19.documentation:
High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 19: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by 
Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 November 2019 on type-approval requirements for motor vehicles and their trailers, and systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles, as regards their general safety and the protection of vehicle occupants and vulnerable road users, amending Regulation (EU) 2018/858 of the European Parliament and of the Council and repealing Regulations (EC) No 78/2009, (EC) No 79/2009 and (EC) No 661/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council and Commission Regulations (EC) No 631/2009, (EU) No 406/2010, (EU) No 672/2010, (EU) No 1003/2010, (EU) No 1005/2010, (EU) No 1008/2010, (EU) No 1009/2010, (EU) No 19/2011, (EU) No 109/2011, (EU) No 458/2011, (EU) No 65/2012, (EU) No 130/2012, (EU) No 347/2012, (EU) No 351/2012, (EU) No 1230/2012 and (EU) 2015/166 (OJ L 325, 16.12.2019, p. 1)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-19.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(19)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-2.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 2: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by Directive 2009/48/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 18 June 2009 on the safety of toys (OJ L 170, 30.6.2009, p. 1)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-2.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(2)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-20.documentation:
High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 20: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by 
Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 4 July 2018 on common rules in the field of civil aviation and establishing a European Union Aviation Safety Agency, and amending Regulations (EC) No 2111/2005, (EC) No 1008/2008, (EU) No 996/2010, (EU) No 376/2014 and Directives 2014/30/EU and 2014/53/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council, and repealing Regulations (EC) No 552/2004 and (EC) No 216/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council and Council Regulation (EEC) No 3922/91 (OJ L 212, 22.8.2018, p. 1), in so far as the design, production and placing on the market of aircrafts referred to in Article 2(1), points (a) and (b) thereof, where it concerns unmanned aircraft and their engines, propellers, parts and equipment to control them remotely, are concerned.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-20.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(20)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-3.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 3: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by Directive 2013/53/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 November 2013 on recreational craft and personal watercraft and repealing Directive 94/25/EC (OJ L 354, 28.12.2013, p. 90);
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-3.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(3)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-4.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 4: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by Directive 2014/33/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 February 2014 on the harmonisation of the laws of the Member States relating to lifts and safety components for lifts (OJ L 96, 29.3.2014, p. 251)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-4.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(4)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-5.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 5: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by Directive 2014/34/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 February 2014 on the harmonisation of the laws of the Member States relating to equipment and protective systems intended for use in potentially explosive atmospheres (OJ L 96, 29.3.2014, p. 309);
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-5.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(5)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-6.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 6: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by Directive 2014/53/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 April 2014 on the harmonisation of the laws of the Member States relating to the making available on the market of radio equipment and repealing Directive 1999/5/EC (OJ L 153, 22.5.2014, p. 62)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-6.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(6)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-7.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 7: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by  Directive 2014/68/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 15 May 2014 on the harmonisation of the laws of the Member States relating to the making available on the market of pressure equipment (OJ L 189, 27.6.2014, p. 164)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-7.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(7)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-8.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 8: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by Regulation (EU) 2016/424 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 March 2016 on cableway installations and repealing Directive 2000/9/EC (OJ L 81, 31.3.2016, p. 1)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-8.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(8)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-9.documentation:
High-risk AI system according to Annex I, point 9: AI system that is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product, covered by 
Regulation (EU) 2016/425 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 March 2016 on personal protective equipment and repealing Council Directive 89/686/EEC (OJ L 81, 31.3.2016, p. 51)
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexI-9.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex I(9)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-1-a.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 1a:  Biometrics, remote biometric identification systems. This shall not include AI systems intended to be used for biometric verification the sole purpose of which is to confirm that a specific natural person is the person he or she claims to be.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-1-a.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(1a)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-1-b.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 1b:  Biometrics, AI systems intended to be used for biometric categorisation, according to sensitive or protected attributes or characteristics based on the inference of those attributes or characteristics.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-1-b.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(1b)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-1-c.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 1c:  Biometrics, AI systems intended to be used for emotion recognition.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-1-c.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(1c)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-2.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 2: Critical infrastructure: AI systems intended to be used as safety components in the management and operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, or in the supply of water, gas, heating or electricity
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-2.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(2)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-3-a.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 3a: AI systems intended to be used to determine access or admission or to assign natural persons to educational and vocational training institutions at all levels;
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-3-a.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(3a)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-3-b.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 3b: Education and vocational training: AI systems intended to be used to evaluate learning outcomes, including when those outcomes are used to steer the learning process of natural persons in educational and vocational training institutions at all levels
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-3-b.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(3b)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-3-c.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 3c: Education and vocational training: AI systems intended to be used for the purpose of assessing the appropriate level of education that an individual will receive or will be able to access, in the context of or within educational and vocational training institutions at all levels
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-3-c.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(3c)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-3-d.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 3d: Education and vocational training: AI systems intended to be used for monitoring and detecting prohibited behaviour of students during tests in the context of or within educational and vocational training institutions at all levels
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-3-d.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(3d)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-4-a.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 4a: Employment, workers management and access to self-employment: AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter job applications, and to evaluate candidates
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-4-a.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(4a)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-4-b.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 4b: Employment, workers management and access to self-employment: AI systems intended to be used to make decisions affecting terms of work-related relationships, the promotion or termination of work-related contractual relationships, to allocate tasks based on individual behaviour or personal traits or characteristics or to monitor and evaluate the performance and behaviour of persons in such relationships
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-4-b.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(4b)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-5-a.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 5a: Access to and enjoyment of essential private services and essential public services and benefits: AI systems intended to be used by public authorities or on behalf of public authorities to evaluate the eligibility of natural persons for essential public assistance benefits and services, including healthcare services, as well as to grant, reduce, revoke, or reclaim such benefits and services.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-5-a.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(5a)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-5-b.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 5b: Access to and enjoyment of essential private services and essential public services and benefits: AI systems intended to be used to evaluate the creditworthiness of natural persons or establish their credit score, with the exception of AI systems used for the purpose of detecting financial fraud.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-5-b.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(5b)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-5-c.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 5c: Access to and enjoyment of essential private services and essential public services and benefits: AI systems intended to be used for risk assessment and pricing in relation to natural persons in the case of life and health insurance.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-5-c.label: High-Risk AI System - Annex III(5c)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-5-d.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 5d: Access to and enjoyment of essential private services and essential public services and benefits: AI systems intended to evaluate and classify emergency calls by natural persons or to be used to dispatch, or to establish priority in the dispatching of, emergency first response services, including by police, firefighters and medical aid, as well as of emergency healthcare patient triage systems.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-5-d.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(5d)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-a.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 6a: Law enforcement, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: Law enforcement, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities, or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies in support of law enforcement authorities or on their behalf to assess the risk of a natural person becoming the victim of criminal offences.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-a.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(6a)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-b.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 6b:  Law enforcement, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies in support of law enforcement authorities as polygraphs or similar tools.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-b.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(6b)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-c.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 6c:  AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities, or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies, in support of law enforcement authorities to evaluate the reliability of evidence in the course of the investigation or prosecution of criminal offences.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-c.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(6c)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-d.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 6d:  Law enforcement, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: AI systems intended to be used by law enforcement authorities or on their behalf or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies in support of law enforcement authorities for assessing the risk of a natural person offending or re-offending not solely on the basis of the profiling of natural persons as referred to in Article 3(4) of Directive (EU) 2016/680, or to assess personality traits and characteristics or past criminal behaviour of natural persons or groups.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-d.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(6d)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-e.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 6e:  Law enforcement, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies in support of law enforcement authorities for the profiling of natural persons as referred to in Article 3(4) of Directive (EU) 2016/680 in the course of the detection, investigation or prosecution of criminal offences.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-6-e.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(6e)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-7-a.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 7a: Migration, asylum and border control management, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies as polygraphs or similar tools.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-7-a.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(7a)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-7-b.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 7b: Migration, asylum and border control management, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies to assess a risk, including a security risk, a risk of irregular migration, or a health risk, posed by a natural person who intends to enter or who has entered into the territory of a Member State.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-7-b.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(7b)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-7-c.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 7c: Migration, asylum and border control management, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies to assist competent public authorities for the examination of applications for asylum, visa or residence permits and for associated complaints with regard to the eligibility of the natural persons applying for a status, including related assessments of the reliability of evidence.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-7-c.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(7c)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-7-d.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 7d: Migration, asylum and border control management, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities, or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies, in the context of migration, asylum or border control management, for the purpose of detecting, recognising or identifying natural persons, with the exception of the verification of travel documents.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-7-d.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(7d)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-8-a.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 8a: Administration of justice and democratic processes: AI systems intended to be used by a judicial authority or on their behalf to assist a judicial authority in researching and interpreting facts and the law and in applying the law to a concrete set of facts, or to be used in a similar way in alternative dispute resolution.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-8-a.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(8a)

HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-8-b.documentation: High-risk AI system according to Annex III, Point 8b: Administration of justice and democratic processes: AI systems intended to be used for influencing the outcome of an election or referendum or the voting behaviour of natural persons in the exercise of their vote in elections or referenda. This does not include AI systems to the output of which natural persons are not directly exposed, such as tools used to organise, optimise or structure political campaigns from an administrative or logistical point of view.
HighRiskAISystem-AnnexIII-8-b.label: High-Risk AI System -  Annex III(8b)

HumanOverseer.documentation: The natural person to whom human oversight is assigned
HumanOverseer.label: Human Overseer

InformedConsent.documentation: Informed consent means a (real world test) subject’s freely given, specific, unambiguous and voluntary expression of his or her willingness to participate in a particular testing in real world conditions, after having been informed of all aspects of the testing that are relevant to the subject’s decision to participate
InformedConsent.label: Informed Consent

InstructionForUse.documentation: The information provided by the provider to inform the deployer of, in particular, an AI system’s intended purpose and proper use
InstructionForUse.label: Instruction For Use

IntendedPurpose.documentation: The use for which an AI system is intended by the provider, including the specific context and conditions of use, as specified in the information supplied by the provider in the instructions for use, promotional or sales materials and statements, as well as in the technical documentation
IntendedPurpose.label: Intended Purpose

JusticeSector.documentation: Sector related to administration of justice
JusticeSector.label: Justice Sector

MarketAvailabilityStatus.documentation: Status associated with whether the AI system or GPAI Model is available for distribution or use on the market in the course of a commercial activity
MarketAvailabilityStatus.label: Market Availability Status

MarketPlacementStatus.documentation: Status associated with whether the AI system or GPAI Model has been 'first' made available on the market
MarketPlacementStatus.label: Market Placement Status

MarketSurveillanceAuthority.documentation: The national authority carrying out the activities and taking the measures pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
MarketSurveillanceAuthority.label: Market Surveillance Authority

NationalCompetentAuthority.documentation: A notifying authority or a market surveillance authority; as regards AI systems put into service or used by Union institutions, agencies, offices and bodies, references to national competent authorities or market surveillance authorities in the AI Act shall be construed as references to the European Data Protection Supervisor
NationalCompetentAuthority.label: National Competent Authority

NonpredeterminedChange.documentation: Change associated with the AI system that has not been pre-determined
NonpredeterminedChange.label: Non-Predetermined Change

NotAvailableOnMarket.documentation: not available on a market anywhere in EU or otherwise
NotAvailableOnMarket.label: Not Available on Market

NotPutIntoService.documentation: Status associated with an AI system that has not been put into service
NotPutIntoService.label: Not Put in to Service

NotifiedBody.documentation: A conformity assessment body notified in accordance with the AI Act and other relevant Union harmonisation legislation
NotifiedBody.label: Notified Body

NotifyingAuthority.documentation: The national authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring
NotifyingAuthority.label: Notifying Authority

PlacedOnEUMarket.documentation: Status indicating the first making available of an AI system or a general purpose AI model on the Union market
PlacedOnEUMarket.label: Placed on EU Market

PlacedOnMarket.documentation: Status indicating the first making available of an AI system or a general purpose AI model on the market
PlacedOnMarket.label: Placed on Market

PostMarketMonitoringPlan.documentation: Description of the post-market monitoring plan, as required by the AI Act
PostMarketMonitoringPlan.label: Post-market Monitoring Plan

PostMarketMonitoringSystem.documentation:
All activities carried out by providers of AI systems to collect and review experience gained from the use of AI systems they
place on the market or put into service for the purpose of identifying any need to immediately apply any necessary corrective or preventive actions
PostMarketMonitoringSystem.label: Post-Market Monitoring System

PostMarketMonitoringSystemDocumentation.documentation: Documentation of the post-market monitoring system in place, as required by the AI Act
PostMarketMonitoringSystemDocumentation.label: Post-market Monitoring System Documentation

PostRemoteBiometricIdentificationSystem.documentation: A remote biometric identification system other than a real-time remote biometric identification system
PostRemoteBiometricIdentificationSystem.label: Post Remote Biometric Identification System

PredeterminedChange.documentation: Change associated with the AI system that has been pre-determined
PredeterminedChange.label: Predetermined Change

PrivateSector.documentation: Sector comprising of entities that are privately owned
PrivateSector.label: Private Sector

ProhibitedAISystem.documentation: Prohibited AI system according to Article 5, AI Act
ProhibitedAISystem.label: Prohibited AI System

ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-a.documentation: Prohibited AI system according to Article 5(1a) of the AI Act, indicating an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques beyond a person’s consciousness or purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques, with the objective, or the effect of materially distorting the behaviour of a person or a group of persons by appreciably impairing their ability to make an informed decision, thereby causing them to take a decision that they would not have otherwise taken in a manner that causes or is reasonably likely to cause that person, another person or group of persons significant harm.
ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-a.label: Prohibited AI System - Article 5(1a)

ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-b.documentation: Prohibited AI system according to Article 5(1b) of the AI Act, indicating an AI system that exploits any of the vulnerabilities of a natural person or a specific group of persons due to their age, disability or a specific social or economic situation, with the objective, or the effect, of materially distorting the behaviour of that person or a person belonging to that group in a manner that causes or is reasonably likely to cause that person or another person significant harm.
ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-b.label: Prohibited AI System - Article 5(1b)

ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-c.documentation: Prohibited AI system according to Article 5(1c) of the AI Act, indicating AI systems that evaluate or classify of natural persons or groups of persons over a certain period of time based on their social behaviour or known, inferred or predicted personal or personality characteristics, with the social score leading to either or both of the following:  (i) detrimental or unfavourable treatment of certain natural persons or groups of persons in social contexts that are unrelated to the contexts in which the data was originally generated or collected; (ii) detrimental or unfavourable treatment of certain natural persons or groups of persons that is unjustified or disproportionate to their social behaviour or its gravity;
ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-c.label: Prohibited AI System - Article 5(1c)

ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-d.documentation: Prohibited AI system according to Article 5(1d) of the AI Act, indicating AI system used for making risk assessments of natural persons in order to assess or predict the risk of a natural person committing a criminal offence, based solely on the profiling of a natural person or on assessing their personality traits and characteristics; this prohibition shall not apply to AI systems used to support the human assessment of the involvement of a person in a criminal activity, which is already based on objective and verifiable facts directly linked to a criminal activity
ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-d.label: Prohibited AI System -  Article 5(1d)

ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-e.documentation: Prohibited AI system according to Article 5(1e) of the AI Act, indicating AI systems that create or expand facial recognition databases through the untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage
ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-e.label: Prohibited AI System - Article 5(1e)

ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-f.documentation:
Prohibited AI system according to Article 5(1f) of the AI Act, indicating  AI systems that infer emotions of a natural person in the areas of workplace and education institutions, except where the use of the AI system is
intended to be put in place or into the market for medical or safety reasons
ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-f.label: Prohibited AI System - Article 5(1f)

ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-g.documentation:
Prohibited AI system / risk level according to Article 5(1g) of the AI Act, indicating biometric categorisation systems that categorise individually natural persons based on their biometric data to deduce or infer their race, political
opinions, trade union membership, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life or sexual orientation; this prohibition does
not cover any labelling or filtering of lawfully acquired biometric datasets, such as images, based on biometric data or
categorizing of biometric data in the area of law enforcement.
ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-g.label: Prohibited AI System - Article 5(1g)

ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-h.documentation:
Prohibited AI system according to Article 5(1h) of the AI Act,  the use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purposes of law enforcement, unless and in so far as such use is strictly necessary for one of the following objectives:
(i) the targeted search for specific victims of abduction, trafficking in human beings or sexual exploitation of human
beings, as well as the search for missing persons;
(ii) the prevention of a specific, substantial and imminent threat to the life or physical safety of natural persons or
a genuine and present or genuine and foreseeable threat of a terrorist attack;
(iii) the localisation or identification of a person suspected of having committed a criminal offence, for the purpose of
conducting a criminal investigation or prosecution or executing a criminal penalty for offences referred to in
Annex II and punishable in the Member State concerned by a custodial sentence or a detention order for
a maximum period of at least four years.
ProhibitedAISystem-A5-1-h.label: Prohibited AI System - Article 5(1h)

ProviderHumanOversightMeasure.documentation: Human oversight measures built into the AI system by the provider before it is placed on the market or put into service.
ProviderHumanOversightMeasure.label: Human Oversight Measure by Provider

PublicSector.documentation: Sector comprising of entities that are publicly owned e.g. by the government
PublicSector.label: Public Sector

PubliclyAccessibleSpace.documentation: Any publicly or privately owned physical place accessible to an undetermined number of natural persons, regardless of whether certain conditions for access may apply, and regardless of the potential capacity restrictions
PubliclyAccessibleSpace.label: Publicly Accessible Space

PutIntoService.documentation: Status associated with the supply of an AI system for first use directly to the deployer or for own use for its intended purpose
PutIntoService.label: Put in to Service

PutIntoServiceInEU.documentation: Status associated with the supply of an AI system for first use directly to the deployer or for own use in the Union for its intended purpose
PutIntoServiceInEU.label: Put in to Service In EU

QualityManagementSystem.documentation: A quality management system in place in relation to an AI system that ensures compliance with the AI Act
QualityManagementSystem.label: Quality Management System

RealWorldTestSubject.documentation: A natural person who participates in testing in real world conditions
RealWorldTestSubject.label: Real World Test Subject

RealWorldTestingPlan.documentation: A document that describes the objectives, methodology, geographical, population and temporal scope, monitoring, organisation and conduct of testing in real world conditions.
RealWorldTestingPlan.label: Real World Testing Plan

RealtimeRemoteBiometricIdentificationSys.documentation: A remote biometric identification system, whereby the capturing of biometric data, the comparison and the identification all occur without a significant delay, comprising not only instant identification, but also limited short delays in order to avoid circumvention
RealtimeRemoteBiometricIdentificationSys.label: Real-time Remote Biometric Identification System

ReasonablyForeseeableMisuse.documentation: The use of an AI system in a way that is not in accordance with its intended purpose, but which may result from reasonably foreseeable human behaviour or interaction with other systems, including other AI systems
ReasonablyForeseeableMisuse.label: Reasonably Foreseeable Misuse

RecalledFromService.documentation: An AI system that is returned to the provider or taken out of service or use
RecalledFromService.label: Recalled from Service

RemoteBiometricIdentificationSystem.documentation: An AI system for the purpose of identifying natural persons, without their active involvement, typically at a distance through the comparison of a person’s biometric data with the biometric data contained in a reference database.
RemoteBiometricIdentificationSystem.label: Remote Biometric Identification System

Risk.documentation: The combination of the probability of an occurrence of harm and the severity of that harm
Risk.label: Risk

RiskLevel.documentation: Enumeration of AI Act's risk-based categorisation which determines the prohibitions and obligations for AI systems
RiskLevel.label: Risk Level

RiskLevelHigh.documentation: Risk Level categorising an AI system as "high-risk" as defined in the AI Act Article 6
RiskLevelHigh.label: Risk Level - High

RiskLevelHigh-A6-1.documentation: Risk Level categorising an AI system as "high-risk" as defined in the AI Act Article 6(1), which specifies the sectorial laws mentiond in Annex I
RiskLevelHigh-A6-1.label: Risk Level - High per Article 6(1)

RiskLevelHigh-A6-2.documentation: Risk Level categorising an AI system as "high-risk" as defined in the AI Act Article 6(1), which specifies applications of AI in Annex III
RiskLevelHigh-A6-2.label: Risk Level - High per Article 6(2)

RiskLevelMinimal.documentation: Risk Level categorising an AI system as not being prohibited or high-risk or transparency required as defined in the AI Act
RiskLevelMinimal.label: Risk Level - Minimal

RiskLevelNotHigh.documentation: Risk Level categorising an AI system as not being "high-risk" as defined in the AI Act
RiskLevelNotHigh.label: Risk Level - Not High

RiskLevelPermitted.documentation: Risk Level representing "AI practices" are permitted i.e. not prohibited under the AI Act
RiskLevelPermitted.label: Risk Level - Permitted

RiskLevelProhibited.documentation: Risk Level prohibiting "AI practices" as defined in the AI Act Article 5
RiskLevelProhibited.label: Risk Level - Prohibited

RiskLevelTransparencyRequired.documentation: Risk Level categorising an AI system as not high-risk but where transparency is require as defined in the AI Act
RiskLevelTransparencyRequired.label: Risk Level - Transparency Required

RiskManagementSystem.documentation: A risk management system is a continuous iterative process planned and run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular systematic review and updating
RiskManagementSystem.label: Risk Management System

SafetyComponent.documentation: A component of a product or of an AI system which fulfils a safety function for that product or AI system, or the failure or malfunctioning of which endangers the health and safety of persons or property
SafetyComponent.label: Safety Component

SandboxPlan.documentation: A document agreed between the participating provider and the competent authority describing the objectives, conditions, timeframe, methodology and requirements for the activities carried out within the sandbox
SandboxPlan.label: Sandbox Plan

SeriousIncident.label: Serious Incident

ServiceSupplyStatus.documentation: Status associated with whether the AI system has been supplied for use or put in to service or been recalled or withdrawn
ServiceSupplyStatus.label: Service Supply Status

SubliminalCapability.documentation: Capability that operates beyond (below or above) the threshold of conscious awareness
SubliminalCapability.label: Subliminal Capability

sources.label: Commission guidelines on prohibited AI practices established by AI Act

SubstantialModification.documentation: A change to an AI system after its placing on the market or putting into service which is not foreseen or planned in the initial conformity assessment carried out by the provider and as a result of which the compliance of the AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2 is affected or results in a modification to the intended purpose for which the AI system has been assessed
SubstantialModification.label: Substantial Modification

SystemicRisk.documentation: Q risk that is specific to the high-impact capabilities of general-purpose AI models, having a significant impact on the Union market due to their reach, or due to actual or reasonably foreseeable negative effects on public health, safety, public security, fundamental rights, or the society as a whole, that can be propagated at scale across the value chain
SystemicRisk.label: Systemic Risk

TestReport.documentation: A document that includes a summary of test activities and their results
TestReport.label: Test Report

TestingData.documentation: Data used for providing an independent evaluation of the AI system in order to confirm the expected performance of that system before its placing on the market or putting into service
TestingData.label: Testing Data

TestingRealWorldConditions.documentation: The temporary testing of an AI system for its intended purpose in real-world conditions outside a laboratory or otherwise simulated environment, with a view to gathering reliable and robust data and to assessing and verifying the conformity of the AI system with the requirements of the AI Act and it does not qualify as placing the AI system on the market or putting it into service within the meaning of the AI Act, provided that all the conditions laid down in Article 57 or 60 are fulfilled
TestingRealWorldConditions.label: Testing In Real World Conditions

TrainingData.documentation: Data used for training an AI system through fitting its learnable parameters
TrainingData.label: Training Data

ValidationData.documentation: Data used for providing an evaluation of the trained AI system and for tuning its non-learnable parameters and its learning process in order, inter alia, to prevent underfitting or overfitting
ValidationData.label: Validation Data

WithdrawnFromService.documentation: An AI system that is prevented to be made available in the supply chain
WithdrawnFromService.label: Withdrawn from Service

hasChangeCategory.documentation: Associates the category of change to the AI
hasChangeCategory.label: has change category

hasChangeDescription.documentation: Associates the change description to AI
hasChangeDescription.label: has change description

hasRiskLevel.documentation: Indicates the risk level of the AI system under the AI Act
hasRiskLevel.label: has risk level

A13.documentation: information to be provided where personal data is directly collected from data subject
A13.label: A13 Right to be Informed

A13-Denied.documentation: A denial that A13 applied to the situation
A13-Denied.label: A13 Denied

A13-Eroded.documentation: Erosion of A13 obligation to provide information e.g. by repeatedly and systematically limited or denying it
A13-Eroded.label: A13 Eroded

A13-ExercisePrevented.documentation: The prevention of A13 obligation to provide information e.g. by preventing the data subject from obtaining this information
A13-ExercisePrevented.label: A13 ExercisePrevented

A13-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A13 Right to be Informed
A13-Impact.label: Impact on A13 Right to be Informed

A13-Limited.documentation: A limited fulfillment of A13 obligation to provide information e.g. not providing all required information
A13-Limited.label: A13 Limited

A13-Obstructed.documentation: Obstruction of A13 obligation to provide information e.g. asking for unnecessary identity verification and making it difficult to obtain information
A13-Obstructed.label: A13 Obstructed

A13-Unfulfilled.documentation: Non-fulfillment of A13 obligation to provide required information
A13-Unfulfilled.label: A13 Unfulfilled

A13-Violated.documentation: A violation of A13 obligation regarding providing information
A13-Violated.label: A13 Violated

A14.documentation: information to be provided where personal data is collected from other sources
A14.label: A14 Right to be Informed

A14-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A14 Right to be Informed
A14-Impact.label: Impact on A14 Right to be Informed

A15-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A15 Right of Access
A15-Impact.label: Impact on A15 Right of Access

A16-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A16 Right to Rectification
A16-Impact.label: Impact on A16 Right to Rectification

A17.documentation: Right to erasure ('Right to be forgotten')
A17.label: A17 Right to Erasure

A17-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A17 Right to Erasure
A17-Impact.label: Impact on A17 Right to Erasure

A18-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A18 Right to Restrict Processing
A18-Impact.label: Impact on A18 Right to Restrict Processing

A19.documentation: Right to be notified in case of rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing
A19.label: A19 Right to Rectification Notification

A19-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A19 Right to Rectification Notification
A19-Impact.label: Impact on A19 Right to Rectification Notification

A20-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A20 Right to Data Portability
A20-Impact.label: Impact on A20 Right to Data Portability

A21.documentation: Right to object to processing of personal data
A21.label: A21 Right to object

A21-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A21 Right to object
A21-Impact.label: Impact on A21 Right to object

A22.documentation: Right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing including profiling, and for the data subject to obtain human intervention on the part of the controller for the contested or objected activity, and for the data subject to express his or her point of view, and for the data subject to contest the decision
A22.label: A22 Right to object to automated decision making

A22-3-a.documentation: Right of the data subject to obtain human intervention on the part of the controller for the contested or objected activity
A22-3-a.label: A22 Right to human intervention

A22-3-b.documentation: Right of the data subject to express his or her point of view
A22-3-b.label: A22 Right to express point of view

A22-3-c.documentation: Right of the data subject to contest the decision
A22-3-c.label: A22 Right to contest decision

A22-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A22 Right to object to automated decision making
A22-Impact.label: Impact on A22 Right to object to automated decision making

A45-3.documentation: Personal data can flow freely from the EU to a third country with an Adequacy Decision without any further safeguard being necessary.
A45-3.label: Art 45(3) adequacy decision

A46-2-a.documentation: A legally binding and enforceable instrument between public authorities or bodies
A46-2-a.label: Art 46(2-a) legal instrument

A46-2-b.documentation: ‘Binding Corporate Rules’ means personal data protection policies which are adhered to by a controller or processor established on the territory of a Member State for transfers or a set of transfers of personal data to a controller or processor in one or more third countries within a group of undertakings, or group of enterprises engaged in a joint economic activity
A46-2-b.label: Art 46(2-b) Binding Corporate Rules (BCR)

A46-2-c.documentation: Standard data protection clauses adopted by the Commission
A46-2-c.label: Art 46(2-c) Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) by EC

A46-2-d.documentation: Standard data protection clauses adopted by a Supervisory Authority
A46-2-d.label: Art 46(2-d) Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) by DPA

A46-2-e.documentation: An approved code of conduct pursuant to GDPR Article 40 together with binding and enforceable commitments of the controller or processor in the third country to apply the appropriate safeguards, including as regards individuals´ rights
A46-2-e.label: Art 46(2-e) code of conduct

A46-2-f.documentation: An approved certification mechanism pursuant to GDPR Article 42 together with binding and enforceable commitments of the controller or processor in the third country to apply the appropriate safeguards, including as regards individuals` rights
A46-2-f.label: Art 46(2-f) certification

A46-3-a.documentation: Contractual clauses with controller, processor or recipient of the personal data in the third country or the international organisation.
A46-3-a.label: Art 46(3-a) contractual clauses

A46-3-b.documentation: Provisions to be inserted into administrative arrangements between public authorities or bodies which include enforceable and effective data subject rights
A46-3-b.label: Art 46(3-b) administrative arrangements

A49-1-a.documentation: The data subject has explicitly consented to the proposed transfer, after having been informed of the possible risks of such transfers for the data subject due to the absence of an adequacy decision and appropriate safeguards.
A49-1-a.label: Art 49(1-a) explicit consent

A49-1-b.documentation: The transfer is necessary for the performance of a contract between the data subject and controller or the implementation of pre-contractual measures taken at the data subject´s request.
A49-1-b.label: Art 49(1-b) performance of contract

A49-1-c.documentation: The transfer is necessary for the conclusion or performance of a contract concluded in the interest of the data subject and controller and another natural or legal person.
A49-1-c.label: Art 49(1-c) conclusion of contract

A49-1-d.documentation: The transfer is necessary for important reasons of public interest.
A49-1-d.label: Art 49(1-d) public interest

A49-1-e.documentation: The transfer is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
A49-1-e.label: Art 49(1-e) legal claims

A49-1-f.documentation: The transfer is necessary in order to protect the vital interests of the data subject or of other persons, where the person is physically or legally incapable of giving consent.
A49-1-f.label: Art 49(1-f) protect vital interests

A49-1-g.documentation: The transfer is made from a register which according to Union or Member State law is intended to provide information to the public in general or by any person who can demonstrate a legitimate interest, but only to the extent that the conditions laid down by Union or Member State law for consultation are fulfilled in the particular case.
A49-1-g.label: Art 49(1-g) public register

A49-2.documentation: The transfer is not repetitive, concerns only a limited number of data subjects, is necessary for the purposes of compelling legitimate interests pursued by controller which are not overridden by the interests or rights and freedoms of the data subject, and controller has assessed all the circumstances surrounding the data transfer and have on the basis of that assessment provided suitable safeguards with regard to the protection of personal data.
A49-2.label: Art 49(2) legitimate interests

A6-1-a.documentation: Legal basis based on data subject's given consent to the processing of his or her personal data for one or more specific purposes
A6-1-a.label: Art.6(1-a) consent

A6-1-a-explicit-consent.documentation: Legal basis based on data subject's given explicit consent to the processing of his or her personal data for one or more specific purposes
A6-1-a-explicit-consent.label: Art 6(1-a) explicit consent

A6-1-a-non-explicit-consent.documentation: Legal basis based on data subject's given non-explicit express consent to the processing of his or her personal data for one or more specific purposes
A6-1-a-non-explicit-consent.label: Art.6(1-a) regular consent

A6-1-b.documentation: Legal basis based on performance of a contract to which the data subject is party or in order to take steps at the request of the data subject prior to entering into a contract
A6-1-b.label: Art 6(1-b) contract

A6-1-b-contract-performance.documentation: Legal basis based on performance of a contract to which the data subject is party
A6-1-b-contract-performance.label: Art 6(1-b) contract performance

A6-1-b-enter-into-contract.documentation: Legal basis based on taking steps at the request of the data subject prior to entering into a contract
A6-1-b-enter-into-contract.label: Art 6(1-b) enter into contract

A6-1-c.documentation: Legal basis based on compliance with a legal obligation to which the controller is subject
A6-1-c.label: Art 6(1-c) legal obligation

A6-1-d.documentation: Legal basis based on protecting the vital interests of the data subject or of another natural person
A6-1-d.label: Art 6(1-d) protect vital interests

A6-1-d-data-subject.documentation: Legal basis based on protecting the vital interests of the data subject
A6-1-d-data-subject.label: Art 6(1-d) protect vital interests of data subject

A6-1-d-natural-person.documentation: Legal basis based on protecting the vital interests of another natural person that is not the data subject
A6-1-d-natural-person.label: Art 6(1-d) protect vital interests of natural person

A6-1-e.documentation: Legal basis based on performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller
A6-1-e.label: Art 6(1-e) public interest or official authority

A6-1-e-official-authority.documentation: Legal basis based on the exercise of official authority vested in the controller
A6-1-e-official-authority.label: Art 6(1-e) official authority

A6-1-e-public-interest.documentation: Legal basis based on performance of a task carried out in the public interest
A6-1-e-public-interest.label: Art 6(1-e) public interest

A6-1-f.documentation: Legal basis based on the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the controller or by a third party, except where such interests are overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject which require protection of personal data, in particular where the data subject is a child
A6-1-f.label: Art 6(1-f) legitimate interest

A6-1-f-controller.documentation: Legal basis based on the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the controller, except where such interests are overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject which require protection of personal data, in particular where the data subject is a child
A6-1-f-controller.label: Art 6(1-f) legitimate interest of controller

A6-1-f-third-party.documentation: Legal basis based on the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by a third party, except where such interests are overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject which require protection of personal data, in particular where the data subject is a child
A6-1-f-third-party.label: Art 6(1-f) legitimate interest of third party

A7-3.documentation: Right to withdraw consent at any time
A7-3.label: A7-3 Right to Withdraw Consent

A7-3-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A7-3 Right to Withdraw Consent
A7-3-Impact.label: Impact on A7-3 Right to Withdraw Consent

A77.documentation: Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
A77.label: A77 Right to Complaint

A77-Impact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on A77 Right to Complaint
A77-Impact.label: Impact on A77 Right to Complaint

A78.documentation: Right to an effective judicial remedy against a legally binding decision of a supervisory authority concerning natural or legal person
A78.label: A78 Right to an effective judicial remedy against a supervisory authority

A79.documentation: Right to an effective judicial remedy where the data subject considers that his or her rights have been infringed as a result of the processing of his or her personal data
A79.label: A79 Right to an effective judicial remedy against a controller or processor

A9-2-a.documentation: explicit consent with special categories of data
A9-2-a.label: Art 9(2-a) explicit consent

A9-2-b.documentation: employment and social security and social protection law
A9-2-b.label: Art 9(2-b) employment, social security, social protection law

A9-2-d.documentation: legitimate activities with appropriate safeguards by a foundation, association or any other not-for-profit body with a political, philosophical, religious or trade union aim and on condition that the processing relates solely to the members or to former members of the body or to persons who have regular contact with it in connection with its purposes and that the personal data are not disclosed outside that body without the consent of the data subjects;
A9-2-d.label: Art 9(2-d) legitimate activities

A9-2-e.documentation: data manifestly made public by the data subject
A9-2-e.label: Art 9(2-e) data made public

A9-2-f.documentation: establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims / courts acting in their judicial capacity
A9-2-f.label: Art 9(2-f) judicial process

A9-2-g.documentation: substantial public interest, on the basis of Union or Member State law
A9-2-g.label: Art 9(2-g) public interest

A9-2-h.documentation: preventive or occupational medicine, for the assessment of the working capacity of the employee, medical diagnosis, the provision of health or social care or treatment or the management of health or social care systems and services on the basis of Union or Member State law or pursuant to contract with a health professional and subject to the conditions and safeguards referred to in paragraph 3
A9-2-h.label: Art 9(2-h) health & medicine

A9-2-i.label: Art 9(2-i) public interest in public health

A9-2-j.documentation: public interest, scientific or historical research purposes or statistical purposes based on Union or Member State law
A9-2-j.label: Art 9(2-j) public interest, scientific research, statistical purpose

AccountabilityPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating the controller shall be responsible for, and be able to demonstrate compliance with the other principles (from Art.5-1)
AccountabilityPrinciple.label: Accountability Principle

AccuracyPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating personal data must be accurate and, where necessary, kept up to date; every reasonable step must be taken to ensure that personal data that are inaccurate, having regard to the purposes for which they are processed, are erased or rectified without delay used for
AccuracyPrinciple.label: Accuracy Principle

AdHocContractualClauses.documentation: Contractual Clauses not drafted by the EU Commission, e.g. by the Controller
AdHocContractualClauses.label: AdHoc Contractual Clauses

sources.label: EDPB Recommendations 01/2020 on Supplementary Measures and Transfer Tools

AdequacyDecision.documentation: An adequacy decision as per GDPR Art.45(3) for the transfer of data to a third country or an international organisation
AdequacyDecision.label: Adequacy Decision

AvailabilityBreach.documentation: A data breach where there is an accidental or unauthorised loss of access to or destruction of personal data
AvailabilityBreach.label: Availability Breach

sources.label: EDPB Guidelines 9/2022 on personal data breach notification under GDPR

BalancingTest.documentation: An assessment of whether the individual's interests override the interests of the controller
BalancingTest.label: Balancing Test

BindingCorporateRules.documentation: ‘Binding Corporate Rules’ means personal data protection policies which are adhered to by a controller or processor established on the territory of a Member State for transfers or a set of transfers of personal data to a controller or processor in one or more third countries within a group of undertakings, or group of enterprises engaged in a joint economic activity
BindingCorporateRules.label: Binding Corporate Rules (BCR)

BiometricData.documentation: ‘Biometric Data’ means personal data resulting from specific technical processing relating to the physical, physiological or behavioural characteristics of a natural person, which allow or confirm the unique identification of that natural person, such as facial images or dactyloscopic data
BiometricData.label: Biometric Data

BreachNotificationNotNeeded.documentation: Data Breach notifications to DPA or Data Subjects are not required
BreachNotificationNotNeeded.label: Breach Notification Not Needed

CertificationMechanismsForDataTransfers.documentation: Certification and its binding or specified mechanisms intended to provide sufficient safeguards for data transfers
CertificationMechanismsForDataTransfers.label: Certification Mechanisms for Data Transfers

sources.label: EDPB Recommendations 01/2020 on Supplementary Measures and Transfer Tools

CodesOfConductForDataTransfers.documentation: Codes of Conduct that outline sufficient safeguards for carrying out data transfers
CodesOfConductForDataTransfers.label: Codes of Conduct for Data Transfers

sources.label: EDPB Recommendations 01/2020 on Supplementary Measures and Transfer Tools

ConcernedSupervisoryAuthority.documentation: Concerned Supervisory Authority' or 'supervisory authority concerned’ means a supervisory authority which is concerned by the processing of personal data because: (a) the controller or processor is established on the territory of the Member State of that supervisory authority; (b) data subjects residing in the Member State of that supervisory authority are substantially affected or likely to be substantially affected by the processing; or (c) a complaint has been lodged with that supervisory authority
ConcernedSupervisoryAuthority.label: Concerned Supervisory Authority

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

ConfidentialityBreach.documentation: A data breach where there is an unauthorised or accidental disclosure of or access to personal data
ConfidentialityBreach.label: Confidentiality Breach

sources.label: EDPB Guidelines 9/2022 on personal data breach notification under GDPR

Consent.documentation: Consent’ of the data subject means any freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous indication of the data subject’s wishes by which he or she, by a statement or by a clear affirmative action, signifies agreement to the processing of personal data relating to him or her
Consent.label: Consent

Controller.documentation: ‘Controller’ means the natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body which, alone or jointly with others, determines the purposes and means of the processing of personal data; where the purposes and means of such processing are determined by Union or Member State law, the controller or the specific criteria for its nomination may be provided for by Union or Member State law
Controller.label: Controller

ControllerBreachNotice.documentation: Notice regarding a data breach to the Controller
ControllerBreachNotice.label: Controller Breach Notice

ControllerBreachNotificationNeeded.documentation: Data Breach notification to the Controller is required
ControllerBreachNotificationNeeded.label: Controller Breach Notification Needed

CrossBorderDataBreach.documentation: A data breach involving cross-border data subjects or processing operations
CrossBorderDataBreach.label: Cross-Border Data Breach

sources.label: EDPB Guidelines 9/2022 on personal data breach notification under GDPR

CrossBorderProcessing.documentation: ‘Cross-Border Processing’ means either: (a) processing of personal data which takes place in the context of the activities of establishments in more than one Member State of a controller or processor in the Union where the controller or processor is established in more than one Member State; or (b) processing of personal data which takes place in the context of the activities of a single establishment of a controller or processor in the Union but which substantially affects or is likely to substantially affect data subjects in more than one Member State
CrossBorderProcessing.label: Cross Border Processing

DBIAIndicatesHighRisk.documentation: DBIA identifying high risk levels regarding rights and freedoms of natural persons
DBIAIndicatesHighRisk.label: DBIA Indicates High Risk

DBIAIndicatesLowRisk.documentation: DBIA identifying low risk levels regarding rights and freedoms of natural persons
DBIAIndicatesLowRisk.label: DBIA Indicates Low Risk

DBIAIndicatesNoRisk.documentation: DBIA identifying no risk is present regarding rights and freedoms of natural persons
DBIAIndicatesNoRisk.label: DBIA Indicates No Risk

DBIARiskStatus.documentation: Status reflecting the status of risk associated with a DBIA regarding rights and freedoms of natural persons
DBIARiskStatus.label: DBIA Risk Status

DPABreachInitialNotice.documentation: Notice sent by a Controller within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach to the competent DPA, with justifications provided where the notice is made after 72 hours
DPABreachInitialNotice.label: DPA Breach Initial Notice

DPABreachNotice.documentation: Notice regarding a data breach to the DPA
DPABreachNotice.label: DPA Breach Notice

DPABreachNotificationNeeded.documentation: Data Breach notification to the DPA is required
DPABreachNotificationNeeded.label: DPA Breach Notification Needed

DPABundledBreachNotice.documentation: Notice sent by a Controller to the DPA regarding multiple data breaches concerning the same type of personal data
DPABundledBreachNotice.label: DPA Bundled Breach Notice

sources.label: EDPB Guidelines 9/2022 on personal data breach notification under GDPR

DPAPhasedBreachNotice.documentation: Notice sent to a DPA in phases i.e. by providing incremental information as it becomes available or is requested following previously submitted notifications
DPAPhasedBreachNotice.label: DPA Phased Breach Notice

sources.label: EDPB Guidelines 9/2022 on personal data breach notification under GDPR

DPIAConformant.documentation: Expressing the specified process is conformant with a DPIA
DPIAConformant.label: DPIA Conformant

DPIAConformity.documentation: Conformity of a process with a DPIA
DPIAConformity.label: DPIA Conformity

DPIAIndicatesNoRisk.documentation: DPIA identifying no risk is present
DPIAIndicatesNoRisk.label: DPIA Indicates No Risk

DPIANecessityAssessment.documentation: Process that determines whether a DPIA is necessary
DPIANecessityAssessment.label: DPIA Necessity Assessment

DPIANecessityStatus.documentation: Status reflecting whether a DPIA is necessary
DPIANecessityStatus.label: DPIA Necessity Status

DPIANonConformant.documentation: Expressing the specified process is not conformant with a DPIA
DPIANonConformant.label: DPIA Non-Conformant

DPIANotRequired.documentation: Condition where a DPIA is not required
DPIANotRequired.label: DPIA Not Required

DPIAOutcome.documentation: Process representing determining outcome of a DPIA
DPIAOutcome.label: DPIA Outcome

DPIAOutcomeDPAConsultation.documentation: DPIA outcome status indicating a DPA consultation is required
DPIAOutcomeDPAConsultation.label: DPIA Outcome DPA Consultation

DPIAOutcomeHighResidualRisk.documentation: DPIA outcome status indicating high residual risk which are not acceptable for continuation
DPIAOutcomeHighResidualRisk.label: DPIA Outcome High Residual Risk

DPIAOutcomeRisksAcceptable.documentation: DPIA outcome status indicating residual risks remain and are acceptable for continuation
DPIAOutcomeRisksAcceptable.label: DPIA Outcome Risks Acceptable

DPIAOutcomeRisksMitigated.documentation: DPIA outcome status indicating (all) risks have been mitigated
DPIAOutcomeRisksMitigated.label: DPIA Outcome Risks Mitigated

DPIAOutcomeStatus.documentation: Status reflecting the outcomes of a DPIA
DPIAOutcomeStatus.label: DPIA Outcome Status

DPIAProcedure.documentation: Process representing carrying out a DPIA
DPIAProcedure.label: DPIA Procedure

DPIAProcessingRecommendation.documentation: Recommendation from the DPIA regarding processing
DPIAProcessingRecommendation.label: DPIA Processing Recommendation

DPIARecommendsProcessingContinue.documentation: Recommendation from a DPIA that the processing may continue
DPIARecommendsProcessingContinue.label: DPIA Recommends Processing Continue

DPIARecommendsProcessingNotContinue.documentation: Recommendation from a DPIA that the processing should not continue
DPIARecommendsProcessingNotContinue.label: DPIA Recommends Processing Not Continue

DPIARequired.documentation: Condition where a DPIA is required
DPIARequired.label: DPIA Required

DPIARiskStatus.documentation: Status reflecting the status of risk associated with a DPIA
DPIARiskStatus.label: DPIA Risk Status

DataBreach.documentation: Data Breach' or ‘Personal Data Breach’ means a breach of security leading to the accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to, personal data transmitted, stored or otherwise processed
DataBreach.label: Data Breach

DataBreachConcludingReport.documentation: Documented information about a concluded data breach incident
DataBreachConcludingReport.label: Data Breach Concluding Report

DataBreachDetectionReport.documentation: Documented information about a data breach being detected
DataBreachDetectionReport.label: Data Breach Detection Report

DataBreachJustification.documentation: A Justification used in the context of data breach related processes and communications
DataBreachJustification.label: Data Breach Justification

DataBreachNotice.documentation: Notice associated with data breach providing information in compliance with GDPR
DataBreachNotice.label: Data Breach Notice

DataBreachNoticeRequirement.documentation: Whether a Data Breach notification is required
DataBreachNoticeRequirement.label: Data Breach Notice Requirement

DataBreachOngoingReport.documentation: Documented information about an ongoing data breach
DataBreachOngoingReport.label: Data Breach Ongoing Report

DataBreachPreliminaryReport.documentation: Documented information about preliminary assessment regarding a data breach
DataBreachPreliminaryReport.label: Data Breach Preliminary Report

DataBreachRegister.documentation: Register of data breaches containing facts relating to the personal data breach, its effects and the remedial action taken
DataBreachRegister.label: Data Breach Register

DataBreachReport.documentation: Documented information about a data breach incident, its handling, assessments, and notifications
DataBreachReport.label: Data Breach Report

DataMinimisationPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating personal data must be processed adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed
DataMinimisationPrinciple.label: Data Minimisation Principle

DataProtectionAuthority.documentation: ‘Supervisory Authority’ or 'Data Protection Authority' means an independent public authority which is established by a Member State pursuant to Article 51
DataProtectionAuthority.label: Data Protection Authority

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

DataSubject.documentation: Data Subject' means a natural person who can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identifier such as a name, an identification number, location data, an online identifier or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person
DataSubject.label: Data Subject

DataSubjectBreachNotice.documentation: Notice regarding a data breach to the Data Subject
DataSubjectBreachNotice.label: Data Subject Breach Notice

DataSubjectBreachNotificationNeeded.documentation: Data Breach notification to the Data Subject is required
DataSubjectBreachNotificationNeeded.label: Data Subject Breach Notification Needed

DataTransferTool.documentation: A legal instrument or tool intended to assist or justify data transfers
DataTransferTool.label: Data Transfer Tool

sources.label: GDPR Art.46 and EDPB Recommendations 01/2020 on Supplementary Measures and Transfer Tools

DirectDataCollectionNotice.documentation: A Notice provided in fulfilment of GDPR's Art.13 regarding information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject
DirectDataCollectionNotice.label: Direct Data Collection Notice

Disproportionate.documentation: Status representing the activity or context is disproportionate i.e. it is not proportionate
Disproportionate.label: Disproportionate

Establishment.documentation: Establishment is a Legal Entity which implies the effective and real exercise of activities through stable arrangements (with a presumed parent or primary establishment)
Establishment.label: Establishment

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

FairnessPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating personal data must be processed processed fairly in relation to the data subject
FairnessPrinciple.label: Fairness Principle

GDPRComplianceUnknown.documentation: State where lawfulness or compliance with GDPR is unknown
GDPRComplianceUnknown.label: GDPR Compliance Unknown

GDPRCompliant.documentation: State of being lawful or legally compliant for GDPR
GDPRCompliant.label: GDPR Compliant

GDPRLawfulness.documentation: Status or state associated with being lawful or legally compliant regarding GDPR
GDPRLawfulness.label: GDPR Lawfulness

GDPRNonCompliant.documentation: State of being unlawful or legally non-compliant for GDPR
GDPRNonCompliant.label: GDPR Non-compliant

GDPRRightsImpact.documentation: Something that acts as or is considered as an impact on one or more rights defined by GDPR
GDPRRightsImpact.label: GDPR Rights Impact

GeneticData.documentation: ‘Genetic Data’ means personal data relating to the inherited or acquired genetic characteristics of a natural person which give unique information about the physiology or the health of that natural person and which result, in particular, from an analysis of a biological sample from the natural person in question
