GeneticData.label: Genetic Data

HealthData.documentation: Health Data' or 'data concerning health’ means personal data related to the physical or mental health of a natural person, including the provision of health care services, which reveal information about his or her health status
HealthData.label: Health Data

IndirectDataCollectionNotice.documentation: A Notice provided in fulfilment of GDPR's Art.14 regarding information to be provided where personal data are not collected from the data subject
IndirectDataCollectionNotice.label: Indirect Data Collection Notice

InformationSocietyService.documentation: Information Society Service’ means a service as defined in point (b) of Article 1(1) of Directive (EU) 2015/1535 of the European Parliament and of the Council
InformationSocietyService.label: Information Society Service

IntegrityBreach.documentation: A data breach where there is an unauthorised or accidental alteration of personal data
IntegrityBreach.label: Integrity Breach

sources.label: EDPB Guidelines 9/2022 on personal data breach notification under GDPR

IntegrityConfidentialityPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating personal data must be processed in a manner that ensures appropriate security of the personal data, including protection against unauthorised or unlawful processing and against accidental loss, destruction or damage, using appropriate technical or organisational measures
IntegrityConfidentialityPrinciple.label: Integrity Confidentiality Principle

InternationalOrganisation.documentation: ‘International Organisation’ means an organisation and its subordinate bodies governed by public international law, or any other body which is set up by, or on the basis of, an agreement between two or more countries
InternationalOrganisation.label: International Organisation

JustificationA12Complexity.documentation: Justification that the request under A15-A22 is delayed due to complexity in fulfilling it
JustificationA12Complexity.label: Justification A12 - Complexity

JustificationA12Delay.documentation: Justification that the request under A15-A22 is delayed
JustificationA12Delay.label: Justification A12 - Delay

JustificationA12HighVolume.documentation: Justification that the request under A15-A22 is delayed due to high volume of similar requestes required to be fulfilled
JustificationA12HighVolume.label: Justification A12 - High Volume

JustificationA12IdentityFailure.documentation: Justification that a request under A14-21 could not be fulfilled due to lack of identity verification
JustificationA12IdentityFailure.label: Justification A12 - Identity Failure

JustificationA12IdentityRequired.documentation: Justification that a request under A14-21 could not be fulfilled due to lack of identity verification, and therefore requires additional information to complete the identity verification request
JustificationA12IdentityRequired.label: Justification A12 - Identity Required

JustificationA12InformationRequired.documentation: Justification that the request under A14-21 could not be fulfilled due to additional information being required
JustificationA12InformationRequired.label: Justification A12 - Information Required

JustificationA12LackOfIntent.documentation: Justification that a request under A13-A22 and A34 is manifestly unfounded - in particular due to a lack of intent - and therefore is being charged a fee or is being refused
JustificationA12LackOfIntent.label: Justification A12 - Lack Of Intent

JustificationA12MaliciousIntent.documentation: Justification that a request under A13-A22 and A34 is manifestly unfounded - in particular due to malicious intent - and therefore is being charged a fee or is being refused
JustificationA12MaliciousIntent.label: Justification A12 - Malicious Intent

JustificationA12ManifestlyExcessive.documentation: Justification that a request under A13-A22 and A34 is manifestly excessive and therefore is being charged a fee or is being refused
JustificationA12ManifestlyExcessive.label: Justification A12 - Manifestly Excessive

JustificationA12ManifestlyUnfounded.documentation: Justification that a process under A13-A22 and A34 is manifestly unfounded and therefore is being charged a fee or is being refused
JustificationA12ManifestlyUnfounded.label: Justification A12 - Manifestly Unfounded

JustificationA13EntityAlreadyInformed.documentation: Justification that A13 obligations for providing information do not apply as the data subject already has the information
JustificationA13EntityAlreadyInformed.label: Justification A13 - Entity Already Informed

JustificationA14ConfidentialityCompromis.documentation: Justification that A14 obligations for providing information cannot be fulfilled as the personal data must remain confidential subject to an obligation of professional secrecy regulated by Union or Member State law, including a statutory obligation of secrecy
JustificationA14ConfidentialityCompromis.label: Justification A14 - Confidentiality Compromised

JustificationA14DisproportionateEffort.documentation: Justification that A14 obligations for providing information will require a disproportionate effort to fulfill
JustificationA14DisproportionateEffort.label: Justification A14 - Disproportionate Effort

JustificationA14EntityAlreadyInformed.documentation: Justification that A14 obligations for providing information do not apply as the data subject already has the information
JustificationA14EntityAlreadyInformed.label: Justification A14 - Entity Already Informed

JustificationA14FulfilmentImpossible.documentation: Justification that A14 obligations for providing information are impossible to fulfill
JustificationA14FulfilmentImpossible.label: Justification A14 - Fulfilment Impossible

JustificationA14LegallyExempted.documentation: Justification that A14 obligations for providing information is legally exempted
JustificationA14LegallyExempted.label: Justification A14 - Legally Exempted

JustificationA14ObjectivesImpaired.documentation: Justification that A14 obligations for providing information will (seriously) impair the objectives of the processing
JustificationA14ObjectivesImpaired.label: Justification A14 - Objectives Impaired

JustificationA17Archiving.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten could not be completed due to
JustificationA17Archiving.label: Justification A17 - Archiving

JustificationA17ChildData.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten is being exercised as the personal data of a child have been collected for information society services referred to in A8(1)
JustificationA17ChildData.label: Justification A17 - Child Data

JustificationA17FreedomOfExpression.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten could not be completed as the processing is necessary for exercising the right of freedom of expression and information
JustificationA17FreedomOfExpression.label: Justification A17 - Freedom Of Expression

JustificationA17LegalClaims.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten could not be completed due to
JustificationA17LegalClaims.label: Justification A17 - Legal Claims

JustificationA17LegalErasure.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten is being exercised as the personal data have to be erased for compliance with a legal obligation in Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject
JustificationA17LegalErasure.label: Justification A17 - Legal Erasure

JustificationA17LegallyRequired.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten could not be completed as the processing is required for compliance with a legal obligation
JustificationA17LegallyRequired.label: Justification A17 - Legally Required

JustificationA17NoLegalBasis.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten is being exercised as the corresponding consent has been withdrawn and there is no other legal basis for the processing
JustificationA17NoLegalBasis.label: Justification A17 - No Legal Basis

JustificationA17NonNecessity.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten is being exercised as the personal data are no longer necessary in relation to the purposes for which they were collected or otherwise processed
JustificationA17NonNecessity.label: Justification A17 - Non-Necessity

JustificationA17ObjectA21.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten is being exercised through A21 right to object where there are no overriding legitimate grounds for the processing (A21-1) or as an objection to direct marketing (A21-2)
JustificationA17ObjectA21.label: Justification A17 - Object A21

JustificationA17OfficialAuthority.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten could not be completed due to
JustificationA17OfficialAuthority.label: Justification A17 - Official Authority

JustificationA17PublicHealth.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten could not be completed due to
JustificationA17PublicHealth.label: Justification A17 - Public Health

JustificationA17PublicInterest.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten could not be completed due to
JustificationA17PublicInterest.label: Justification A17 - Public Interest

JustificationA17UnlawfulProcessing.documentation: Justification that the A17 right to erasure or to be forgotten is being exercised as the personal data have been unlawfully processed
JustificationA17UnlawfulProcessing.label: Justification A17 - Unlawful Processing

JustificationA33BreachedDataIneffective.documentation: Justification that the personal data breach was not communicated to the data subject as the controller has implemented appropriate technical and organisational protection measures, and those measures were applied to the personal data affected by the personal data breach, in particular those that render the personal data unintelligible to any person who is not authorised to access it, such as encryption i.e. the breached data cannot be effectively used
JustificationA33BreachedDataIneffective.label: Justification A33 - Breached Data Ineffective

JustificationA33DisproportionateEffort.documentation: Justification that the personal data breach was not communicated to the data subject as it would involve disproportionate effort, and that a public communication or similar measure whereby the data subjects are informed in an equally effective manner has been deployed
JustificationA33DisproportionateEffort.label: Justification A33 - Disproportionate Effort

JustificationA33NotificationDelay.documentation: Justification for why the notification about personal data breach to the authority was not communicated within 72 hours after having become aware of it
JustificationA33NotificationDelay.label: Justification A33 - Notification Delay

JustificationA33RiskMitigated.documentation: Justification that the personal data breach was not communicated to the data subject as the controller has taken subsequent measures which ensure that the high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects is no longer likely to materialise
JustificationA33RiskMitigated.label: Justification A33 - Risk Mitigated

JustificationA33RiskUnlikely.documentation: Justification that the notification about personal data breach was not communicated to the authority as it is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
JustificationA33RiskUnlikely.label: Justification A33 - Risk Unlikely

LawfulnessPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating personal data must be processed processed in a lawful manner in relation to the data subject
LawfulnessPrinciple.label: Lawfulness Principle

LeadSupervisoryAuthority.documentation: Authority with the primary responsibility for dealing with a cross-border data processing activity
LeadSupervisoryAuthority.label: Lead Supervisory Authority

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

LocalSupervisoryAuthority.documentation: Authority associated with the main or local establishment of an organisation
LocalSupervisoryAuthority.label: Local Supervisory Authority

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

MainEstablishment.documentation: Main Establishment' means as regards a controller with establishments in more than one Member State, the place of its central administration in the Union, unless the decisions on the purposes and means of the processing of personal data are taken in another establishment of the controller in the Union and the latter establishment has the power to have such decisions implemented, in which case the establishment having taken such decisions is to be considered to be the main establishment; as regards a processor with establishments in more than one Member State, the place of its central administration in the Union, or, if the processor has no central administration in the Union, the establishment of the processor in the Union where the main processing activities in the context of the activities of an establishment of the processor take place to the extent that the processor is subject to specific obligations under this Regulation;
MainEstablishment.label: Main Establishment

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

NecessityAssessment.documentation: An assessment of whether the processing of personal data is necessary to achieve the stated aims, where necessary indicates a lack of other means which could have been used instead
NecessityAssessment.label: Necessity Assessment

PersonalData.documentation: Personal Data' means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person (‘Data Subject’)
PersonalData.label: Personal Data

Processing.documentation: ‘Processing’ means any operation or set of operations which is performed on personal data or on sets of personal data, whether or not by automated means, such as collection, recording, organisation, structuring, storage, adaptation or alteration, retrieval, consultation, use, disclosure by transmission, dissemination or otherwise making available, alignment or combination, restriction, erasure or destruction
Processing.label: Processing

Processor.documentation: ‘Processor’ means a natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body which processes personal data on behalf of the controller
Processor.label: Processor

ProcessorBreachNotice.documentation: Notice regarding a data breach to the Processor
ProcessorBreachNotice.label: Processor Breach Notice

ProcessorBreachNotificationNeeded.documentation: Data Breach notification to the Processor is required
ProcessorBreachNotificationNeeded.label: Processor Breach Notification Needed

Profiling.documentation: ‘Profiling’ means any form of automated processing of personal data consisting of the use of personal data to evaluate certain personal aspects relating to a natural person, in particular to analyse or predict aspects concerning that natural person’s performance at work, economic situation, health, personal preferences, interests, reliability, behaviour, location or movements
Profiling.label: Profiling

ProportionalityAssessment.documentation: Proportionality is a general principle of EU law, which when applied for the GDPR requires striking a balance between the processing of personal data and the resulting impacts on rights. More simply, the processing should not result in a disproportionate impact on rights
ProportionalityAssessment.label: Proportionality Assessment

ProportionalityStatus.documentation: Status indicating whether the specific activity or context is proportionate
ProportionalityStatus.label: Proportionality Status

Proportionate.documentation: Status representing the activity or context is proportionate
Proportionate.label: Proportionate

Pseudonymisation.documentation: Pseudonymisation’ means the processing of personal data in such a manner that the personal data can no longer be attributed to a specific data subject without the use of additional information, provided that such additional information is kept separately and is subject to technical and organisational measures to ensure that the personal data are not attributed to an identified or identifiable natural person
Pseudonymisation.label: Pseudonymisation

PurposeCompatibility.documentation: Status representing the compatibility of the new purpose with the principle of purpose limitation according to the GDPR
PurposeCompatibility.label: Purpose Compatibility

PurposeCompatibilityAssessment.documentation: An assessment for evaluating the compatibility of the new purpose with the principle of purpose limitation according to the GDPR
PurposeCompatibilityAssessment.label: Purpose Compatibility Assessment

PurposeCompatible.documentation: Status representing the new purpose is compatible with the principle of purpose limitation according to the GDPR
PurposeCompatible.label: Purpose Compatible

PurposeIncompatible.documentation: Status representing the new purpose is incompatible with the principle of purpose limitation according to the GDPR
PurposeIncompatible.label: Purpose Incompatible

PurposeLimitationPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating personal data collected for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes and not further processed in a manner that is incompatible with those purposes; further processing for archiving purposes in the public interest, scientific or historical research purposes or statistical purposes shall, in accordance with Article 89(1), not be considered to be incompatible with the initial purposes
PurposeLimitationPrinciple.label: Purpose Limitation Principle

Recipient.documentation: ‘Recipient’ means a natural or legal person, public authority, agency or another body, to which the personal data are disclosed, whether a third party or not
Recipient.label: Recipient

Representative.documentation: Representative’ means a natural or legal person established in the Union who, designated by the controller or processor in writing pursuant to Article 27, represents the controller or processor with regard to their respective obligations under this Regulation
Representative.label: Representative

RightsRecipientsNotice.documentation: A Notice provided in fulfilment of GDPR's Art.19 regarding Recipients to whom a rights exercise has been communicated, such as regarding rectification (A.16) or erasure of personal data (A.17) or restriction of processing (A.18)
RightsRecipientsNotice.label: Rights Recipients Notice

SARNotice.documentation: A Notice provided in fulfilment of GDPR's Art.15 regarding information to be provided for Right of Access or Subject Access Request (SAR)
SARNotice.label: SAR Notice

SCCByCommission.documentation: Standard contractual clauses adopted by the Commission in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in GDPR Article 93(2)
SCCByCommission.label: SCCs adopted by Commission

SCCBySupervisoryAuthority.documentation: Standard data protection clauses adopted by a supervisory authority and approved by the Commission pursuant to the examination procedure referred to in GDPR Article 93(2)
SCCBySupervisoryAuthority.label: SCCs adopted by Supervisory Authority

SingleEstablishment.documentation: A legal entity that is established in only one Member State
SingleEstablishment.label: Single Establishment

StandardContractualClauses.documentation: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) are pre-approved clauses by the EU for ensuring appropriate data protection safeguards intended for data transfers from the EU to third countries
StandardContractualClauses.label: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC)

sources.label: Implementing Decision on SCC for Data Transfers

StorageLimitationPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating personal data must be kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the personal data are processed; personal data may be stored for longer periods insofar as the personal data will be processed solely for archiving purposes in the public interest, scientific or historical research purposes or statistical purposes in accordance with Article 89(1) subject to implementation of the appropriate technical and organisational measures required by this Regulation in order to safeguard the rights and freedoms of the data subject
StorageLimitationPrinciple.label: Storage Limitation Principle

SuitabilityAssessment.documentation: An assessment of whether the processing of personal data is suitable to achieve the stated aims
SuitabilityAssessment.label: Suitability Assessment

SupplementaryMeasure.documentation: Supplementary measures are intended to additionally provide safeguards or guarantees to bring the resulting protection in line with EU requirements
SupplementaryMeasure.label: Supplementary Measure

sources.label: EDPB Recommendations 01/2020 on Supplementary Measures and Transfer Tools

ThirdParty.documentation: ‘Third Party’ means a natural or legal person, public authority, agency or body other than the data subject, controller, processor and persons who, under the direct authority of the controller or processor, are authorised to process personal data
ThirdParty.label: Third Party

TransparencyPrinciple.documentation: Principle stating personal data must be processed processed in a transparent manner in relation to the data subject
TransparencyPrinciple.label: Transparency Principle

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

hasEstablishment.documentation: Indicates an establishment associated with a legal entity
hasEstablishment.label: has establishment

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1
Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1
Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

hasMainEstablishment.documentation: Indicates the legal entity has specified establishment as its main establishment
hasMainEstablishment.label: has main establishment

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

isMainEstablishmentFor.documentation: Indicates the main establishment for specific legal entity
isMainEstablishmentFor.label: is main establishment for

sources.label: Guidelines 3/2018 on the territorial scope of the GDPR (Article 3) Version 2.1

EarlyWarningReport.documentation: Report sent within 24 hours of detection containing cause of the incident and whether it was unlawful or malicious and whether there is cross-border impact
EarlyWarningReport.label: Early Warning Report

FinalReport.documentation: Report sent within 1 month of incident handling i.e. completing the incident recovery and containing the applied/ongoing measures, and containing a 'detailed description' of the incident including its severity and impact, threat type and root cause that are likely to have triggered the incident, applied and ongoing measures, and - if applicable - cross-border impacts
FinalReport.label: Final Report

IncidentAssessmentReport.documentation: Report sent within 72 hours of detection containing updates on the earlier information as well as initial assessment of severity and impact of the incident as well as any 'indicators of compromise'
IncidentAssessmentReport.label: Incident Assessment Report

InitialFeedbackOnIncident.documentation: Notification from authority to organisation (upon request, within 24 hours or early warning) containing "initial feedback" and guidelines on measures that can be taken in response to a breach
InitialFeedbackOnIncident.label: Initial Feedback on Incident

IntermediateReport.documentation: Report sent upon request which provides updates, if any, to previous information
IntermediateReport.label: Intermediate Report

NIS2ComplianceUnknown.documentation: State where lawfulness or compliance with NIS2 is unknown
NIS2ComplianceUnknown.label: NIS2 Compliance Unknown

NIS2Compliant.documentation: State of being lawful or legally compliant for NIS2
NIS2Compliant.label: NIS2 Compliant

NIS2Lawfulness.documentation: Status or state associated with being lawful or legally compliant regarding NIS2
NIS2Lawfulness.label: NIS2 Lawfulness

NIS2NonCompliant.documentation: State of being unlawful or legally non-compliant for NIS2
NIS2NonCompliant.label: NIS2 Non-compliant

ProgressReport.documentation: Report sent within 1 month of detection if the incident handling has not been completed by then, with updates to previous information
ProgressReport.label: Progress Report

RiskMitigationAdvice.documentation: Notification from organisation to stakeholders regarding risk mitigations to be applied and existence of threats
RiskMitigationAdvice.label: Risk Mitigation Advice

SignificantIncidentNotice.documentation: Notice sent for reporting significant incidents
SignificantIncidentNotice.label: Significant Incident Notice

Instrument.documentation: A directive, regulation or act that imposes obligations.
Instrument.label: Legal instrument

Obligation.documentation: One duty imposed by an instrument, at the granularity a control can address — usually a lettered point of an article.
Obligation.label: Obligation

gdpr-art12.documentation: Information under Articles 13 and 14 and communications under Articles 15 to 22 and 34 must be concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible, in clear and plain language.
gdpr-art12.label: Transparent information, communication and modalities for the exercise of the rights of the data subject

gdpr-art12-3.label: Information on action taken, without undue delay and in any event within one month

gdpr-art12-6.label: Additional information to confirm the identity of the data subject

gdpr-art13.label: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject

gdpr-art14.label: Information to be provided where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject

gdpr-art15.label: Right of access by the data subject

gdpr-art17.label: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten')

gdpr-art19.label: Notification obligation regarding rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing

gdpr-art25.documentation: Technical and organisational measures designed to implement the data-protection principles, decided when the means of processing are determined and again during the processing itself.
gdpr-art25.label: Data protection by design and by default

gdpr-art28.documentation: A controller may use only processors that provide sufficient guarantees, under a contract that binds them to the controller's instructions.
gdpr-art28.label: Processor

gdpr-art30.documentation: A record of the processing activities under the controller's responsibility, covering purposes, categories of data subjects and of personal data, categories of recipients, transfers to third countries, retention periods and the security measures.
gdpr-art30.label: Records of processing activities

gdpr-art32-1.documentation: Appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.
gdpr-art32-1.label: Security of processing

gdpr-art32-1-a.label: Pseudonymisation and encryption of personal data

gdpr-art32-1-b.label: Ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of processing systems and services

gdpr-art32-1-c.label: Ability to restore the availability and access to personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident

gdpr-art32-1-d.label: Process for regularly testing, assessing and evaluating the effectiveness of the measures

gdpr-art33.documentation: Notify without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after becoming aware of the breach, unless it is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.
gdpr-art33.label: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority within 72 hours

gdpr-art33-5.label: Documentation of any personal data breach

gdpr-art34.documentation: Where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, communicate it to the data subject without undue delay.
gdpr-art34.label: Communication of a personal data breach to the data subject

gdpr-art35.documentation: Where a type of processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, assess the impact of the envisaged operations before the processing starts.
gdpr-art35.label: Data protection impact assessment

gdpr-art36.documentation: Consult the supervisory authority before processing where the impact assessment indicates a high risk that the controller has not mitigated.
gdpr-art36.label: Prior consultation of the supervisory authority

gdpr-art37.documentation: Designate a data protection officer where the processing is carried out by a public authority, or where the core activities require regular and systematic monitoring on a large scale or large-scale processing of special categories of data.
gdpr-art37.label: Designation of the data protection officer

gdpr-art37-7.label: Publication of the DPO's contact details and communication to the supervisory authority

gdpr-art39.label: Tasks of the data protection officer

gdpr-art5.documentation: The six principles personal data must be processed under, and the controller's responsibility to demonstrate compliance with them.
gdpr-art5.label: Principles relating to processing of personal data

gdpr-art6-1.documentation: Processing is lawful only if at least one of the six bases in Article 6(1) applies, and the controller must be able to say which.
gdpr-art6-1.label: Lawfulness of processing

gdpr-art6-1-f.label: Legitimate interests of the controller or a third party

instrument.documentation: The instrument an obligation comes from.
instrument.label: instrument

nis2-art21-2.documentation: Appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organisational measures to manage the risks posed to the security of network and information systems, based on an all-hazards approach. The lettered points below are the minimum the measures shall include.
nis2-art21-2.label: Cybersecurity risk-management measures

nis2-art21-2-a.label: Policies on risk analysis and information system security

nis2-art21-2-c.label: Business continuity, such as backup management and disaster recovery, and crisis management

nis2-art21-2-d.label: Supply chain security, including security-related aspects of the relationships with direct suppliers or service providers

nis2-art21-2-e.label: Security in network and information systems acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling and disclosure

nis2-art21-2-f.label: Policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures

nis2-art21-2-g.label: Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training

nis2-art21-2-h.label: Policies and procedures regarding the use of cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption

nis2-art21-2-i.label: Human resources security, access control policies and asset management

nis2-art21-2-j.label: Multi-factor or continuous authentication, secured voice, video and text communications and secured emergency communication systems

3LikelihoodLevels.documentation: Scale with 3 Likelihood Levels from High to Low
